editor_fail.why: The main picture is a 2017 ESA Sentinel-2 view of the Irrawaddy delta. The story and the NASA feature never mention that place. NASA's own images, the subject of the story, show Palaw Township in Myanmar's Myeik District in 2010 and 2026. Readers will take the delta image as the study's map. Also a fact error: the lede says mangroves lost almost 3,000 sq km 'in the late twentieth century' (HI 'बीसवीं सदी के आखिरी दशकों में'), but NASA puts the loss in 1984 to 2010.
editor_fail.fix: Use NASA Earth Observatory's Landsat image of Palaw Township, Myeik District (public domain, from science.nasa.gov/earth/earth-observatory/a-global-rebound-for-mangroves/), captioned 'Mangroves have replaced rice fields in parts of Myanmar's Myeik District (NASA Earth Observatory, Landsat)'. Change the lede to 'between 1984 and 2010' in EN and HI ('1984 से 2010 के बीच').
